title: Verra Mobility and U.S. Bank Bring Simpler Toll Management to Fleets
summary: Verra Mobility and U.S. Bank simplify fleet toll management by integrating toll payments into the Voyager platform for greater visibility and control.
body_markdown:
[Connected Vehicle Services That Make Driving Easier: From Tolling to Fueling and Beyond September 28, 2026](https://www.verramobility.com/connected-vehicle-services-that-make-driving-easier-from-tolling-to-fueling-and-beyond/)[Verra Mobility Appoints Jon Newhard as Chief Executive Officer October 5, 2026](https://www.verramobility.com/verra-mobility-appoints-jon-newhard-as-chief-executive-officer/)


Fleet operators today are under increasing pressure to do more with less. Managing fuel, maintenance, EV charging and toll expenses across multiple systems can create unnecessary complexity, make reporting more difficult and limit visibility into the true cost of operating a fleet.


To help address these challenges, Verra Mobility has partnered with U.S. Bank to integrate toll management services into the Voyager® fleet payment platform. The integration gives fleet operators a new way to manage toll payments alongside other critical transportation expenses through a solution they already use.


For fleets focused on streamlining operations, consolidating expenses into a single payment and reporting ecosystem can provide significant benefits. Through the


[U.S. Bank Voyager Fleet Program](https://www.usbank.com/corporate-and-commercial-banking/industry-expertise/transportation/fleet-solutions/fleet-management.html) , customers can now manage toll expenses alongside fuel, maintenance and EV charging costs, helping reduce administrative burden while providing greater visibility into transportation spending. Toll transactions are automatically paid and recorded, eliminating the need to manage multiple toll accounts and invoices across different agencies and jurisdictions.


As toll roads continue to expand across the country, managing toll payments and violations has become increasingly complicated for many fleets. Different tolling authorities operate independently, often requiring fleet operators to navigate multiple processes, payment methods and reporting systems. Integrating toll management directly into the Voyager platform helps simplify that experience, bringing another important fleet expense into a centralized workflow.


"Managing tolls across the country can quickly become complicated for fleets," said


[Stacey Moser, Chief Customer Officer](https://www.verramobility.com/leadership/stacey-moser/) at Verra Mobility. "By partnering with Voyager, we're giving fleet operators an advanced technology solution designed to handle toll payments, reduce costly toll violations and provide a clearer picture of their toll expenses through a platform they already use."


The integration is powered by one of the nation's largest toll processing networks. Verra Mobility processes more than 300 million toll transactions annually across approximately 7 million fleet vehicles, helping organizations efficiently manage toll payments and violations at scale. Customers benefit from a nationwide toll management solution that reduces unexpected costs, helps maintain compliance and minimizes time spent on back-office administration.


The addition of


[toll management](https://www.verramobility.com/commercial/toll-management/) further expands the capabilities of the Voyager platform, which is already accepted at more than 320,000 locations for fuel purchases, maintenance services and EV charging. For fleets already using Voyager to manage transportation expenses, tolling now becomes another category that can be viewed, tracked and reported within the same program.


By bringing together tolling, fuel, maintenance and charging expenses, fleets gain a more complete picture of transportation costs and a stronger foundation for managing total cost of ownership. The result is greater visibility, simplified reconciliation and better control over fleet spending, all while helping vehicles stay on the road and avoiding costly toll violations.


As fleets continue to seek greater efficiency and operational control, solutions that consolidate critical expenses into a single platform will play an increasingly important role. Through this collaboration, Verra Mobility and U.S. Bank are making it easier for fleet operators to simplify payments, streamline reporting and keep their businesses moving forward.
